Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.util.structure

Class MyLinkedList<E>

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.util.structure.MyLinkedList<E>
Type Parameters:
E - the type of elements the list will store
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MyLinkedList<E> extends Object implements Serializable
The MyLinkedList class implements a simple linked list. This list allows storing generic elements of type E and provides methods for performing basic list manipulation operations such as adding, removing, and searching for elements.
Author:
Bustamante Castellanos Caren Sofia, Hospital Herrera Dylan Mathyus, Ramirez Chacon Alejandra Valenttina, Ruiz Cruz Gabriel Alejandro, Triana Mejia Juan Diego, Vela Cardozo German Octavio
